text:
mika_sales: Quick one 00Finance - I had to pay a country visa fee ($215) out of pocket to get into the client country on short notice. Can this be reimbursed?

bel_finance: Hi Mika 00mika_sales. Please attach the receipt and the embassy confirmation. Policy covers visa fees when travel is company-directed; we need manager approval for non-ticket travel expenses > $200.

tara_travel: Travel ops confirms the client moved the meeting date forward which required an expedited visa application. We have a note on the booking that this was company-requested.

mika_sales: Uploading docs: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1849003456-visa.pdf (embassy receipt) and https://files.redwood.example/itineraries/1849003456-email-confirm.png (email from client requesting earlier visit). Receipt shows "Visa processing fee: $215.00 - Receipt ID VSA-9982"

bel_finance: Got it. @omar_mgr can you confirm this was business-required and approve reimbursement? Also confirm whether Mika used personal card or corpcard.

omar_mgr: Confirming. Manager note: I asked Mika to attend an in-person kickoff that was rescheduled earlier by the client. Approving reimbursement. :white_check_mark:

bel_finance: Thanks. Mika, please submit the expense in Ramp with Expense type = Travel -> Visa/Immunization, tag project-lumin, attach the embassy receipt and client email, and select reimbursement to bank. We'll code to GL 6485. Since this is > $200, we'll route for a secondary review but it's approved.

mika_sales: Submitted RMP-24788. Selected ACH and included last4 7785 as requested.

ramp-bot: Expense RMP-24788 created and routed to Finance. Processing ETA: next payroll cycle; if you need faster reply "urgent" with last4 again.

bel_finance: Received RMP-24788 and docs. Secondary review complete, GL set, ACH queued. Expect payment on next vendor payout. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
